channel.title: AI Frontier Post
channel.description: Dispatches from the AI frontier: AI news, research explainers, frontier lab coverage, and product comparisons.

item.title: J.S. Held's Q3 AI disputes report: the legal fight over AI moves from how models are built to what they do
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: J.S. Held's Q3 2026 AI Disputes Monitor adds 42 matters, bringing the tracked total to 468 AI-related cases. The new filings show courts shifting from training-data copyright fights to what AI systems did after deployment — their outputs, safeguards, automated decisions, and disclosures.

item.title: KT bets the AI buildout needs its own lanes: 800Gbps dedicated lines, 8x the old ceiling
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: KT launched dedicated AI network lines with up to 800Gbps of bandwidth — eight times its old ceiling — built on an all-photonic architecture aimed at GPU clusters and AI data centers spread across Korea.

item.title: ASML's record €11.7B quarter hides a warning: even a 30% capacity jump won't satisfy AI chip demand in 2027–2028
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: ASML posted record Q3 sales of €11.7B on 113 new lithography systems — then told investors its planned 2027 and 2028 tool supply still won't cover customer demand, driven by AI-related investment forecasts.

item.title: Google hands 200 European researchers its best AI models and $3M in compute — Brussels picks who gets in
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Google DeepMind and Google Cloud will give up to 200 European researchers direct access to frontier AI models and $3M in compute credits — with the European Commission choosing who gets in under its RAISE program.

item.title: NEURA Robotics launches Neuron AI, the “brain of the physical world” — robots that see, hear, feel, and remember
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: NEURA Robotics introduced Neuron AI, a Perception-Language-Action foundation model that fuses 3D vision, touch, audio and language with memory — one model running across five robot bodies, debuting with an 11-minute laundry run at NVIDIA GTC Berlin.

item.title: Chainguard's new Harness turns Claude Mythos 5.1 loose on live builds — only reports the bugs it can reproduce
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Chainguard's new Harness service points Anthropic's Claude Mythos 5.1 at a live, isolated build of a customer's application, replays every finding until it reproduces, and delivers an engineer-signed fix — frontier-model security testing without needing frontier-model access.

item.title: Affinity Labs raises $2M to turn creators into software founders — its 'AI factory' grows revenue 100% a month
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: London AI startup Affinity Labs raised a $2 million pre-seed round led by Fuel Ventures to expand its portfolio of creator-led software brands and its proprietary AI-powered product development system. Four creator-led brands are live, revenue is growing 100% a month, and the target is 200 brands by 2030.

item.title: CyCraft named Gartner’s only Pace Setter in AI application security — the sole Asian vendor in the quadrant
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Taiwan’s CyCraft Technology (TWSE: 7823) announced it is the only vendor in the Pace Setters quadrant of Gartner’s Emerging Market Quadrant for AI Application Security, Startup Vendors — and the only Asia-based vendor in the report.

item.title: Google DeepMind and Singapore put a scam-spotting Gemma inside your phone — and it never phones home
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: DeepMind and Singapore's GovTech announced an on-device scam detection model at Singapore International Cyber Week: a two-stage pipeline with a fine-tuned Gemma that flags manipulative chats locally, with zero cloud data egress.

item.title: Physical Intelligence opens the Pi API beta: fine-tune robot foundation models without the GPU cluster
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Physical Intelligence's new Pi API beta lets developers upload robot data, fine-tune its π models on Pi-managed compute, and run inference through a hosted gateway — the lab's first step toward a physical-intelligence foundation the whole robotics ecosystem can build on.

item.title: Toptal points its freelancer empire at AI training: ExpertCrowd launches with a benchmark built to humble coding agents
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Toptal has launched ExpertCrowd, a platform that matches its 30,000+ vetted domain experts to AI labs for RLHF, data generation, and model evaluation — with over $5 million in recurring revenue already booked. Alongside it comes ExpertCrowd-SWE, an 87-codebase coding benchmark the company says exposes more model deficiencies than any other.

item.title: Nature Will unveils Natura-1: a 50B-parameter foundation model for robot hands, trained on a million hours of human hand use
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Nature Will has launched Natura-1, a 50-billion-parameter foundation model for dexterous robot hands — pre-trained on more than a million hours of egocentric human video and built to follow instructions on objects it has never seen.

item.title: Drive a real iPhone with AI: a hands-on guide to ESP32 iPhone Agent
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: ESP32 iPhone Agent (onehumanbeing/esp32-iphone-agent, past 1,500 GitHub stars, MIT) turns a $7 ESP32-S3 board into a USB mouse and keyboard that an AI vision model uses to tap and swipe a real iPhone — no Mac, no developer account, no jailbreak. This tutorial flashes the board, starts the server, and runs its first task.

item.title: Scaleway puts Europe's first commercial AMD AI supercomputer in Sweden — MI355X, revealed at ai-PULSE 2026
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: At ai-PULSE 2026 in Paris, Scaleway announced an AMD Instinct MI355X AI supercomputer for Sweden — its first supercomputer outside France and Europe's first commercial AMD AI system, built with Bull, HPE, Giga Computing, VAST Data and Motul.

item.title: OPPO puts Manus inside its phones: Agent Mode brings multi-step tasks to the Find X10
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: OPPO announced October 13 that Manus' agentic capabilities will power a new Agent Mode in AI Mind Pilot on the upcoming Find X10 Series with ColorOS 17 — breaking a request into multi-step tasks across apps, files and photos, while local tasks stay on the device.

item.title: Liquid AI ships LFM2.5-24B-A2B: a 24B open-weights model that thinks before it acts
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Liquid AI released LFM2.5-24B-A2B, the final and largest model of its LFM2.5 family: 24B parameters with 2B active per token, a 131K context window, and agent-focused training — built to run private AI agents on your own hardware.

item.title: Manulife launches an enterprise AI platform, targets $1B in AI value by 2027
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Manulife's proprietary enterprise AI platform moves the Toronto insurer from isolated AI use cases to a governed, build-once-scale-globally foundation — and the company expects the shift to produce $1 billion in cumulative enterprise AI value by 2027.

item.title: AssemblyAI ranks 50+ LLMs on real voice tasks: the best picks are mostly the cheap ones
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: AssemblyAI's open-source Voice Standard Bench scores more than 50 language models on the tasks voice products actually use — summarization, information extraction, text correction, and dictation — and finds most voice workloads don't need frontier-model prices.

item.title: Canada's Regional AI Initiative hits $700M: Ottawa adds $500M for AI adoption
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Ottawa is unlocking an additional $500 million over five years for AI adoption and commercialization through its regional development agencies, bringing the Regional Artificial Intelligence Initiative to $700 million — and application windows are already open.

item.title: Review your own code like Alibaba does: a hands-on guide to OpenCodeReview
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: OpenCodeReview (alibaba/open-code-review, past 46,000 GitHub stars, Apache-2.0) is the AI code reviewer Alibaba runs internally, now open source. This tutorial installs it, configures a model, and runs it on your own repo: uncommitted changes, branch diffs, and delegation mode.

item.title: NVIDIA open-sources Run:ai: the GPU orchestration stack behind its AI factories goes public
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: NVIDIA is releasing the complete Run:ai platform as open source software, making its production-grade Kubernetes GPU orchestration — including KAI Scheduler, now an Apache 2.0 CNCF Sandbox project — the open foundation of the DSX AI Factory Platform. Eight ecosystem partners announced integrations the same day.

item.title: Workday breaks every job into tasks: Work Intelligence debuts at Rising 2026
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Workday introduced Work Intelligence on October 13, 2026, at Workday Rising 2026 in Las Vegas: it breaks each job into its underlying tasks, ties them to skills via the Skills Cloud — used by 3,450+ customers, built on a 75,000-skill ontology — and shows leaders where AI can help, what it should augment, and what has to stay human. Available now to early-access Workday HCM customers.

item.title: NetBox goes native inside NVIDIA’s AI datacenter OS: partnerships with NVIDIA and Grafana, plus an MCP server for agents
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: At its first NetBox Evolve conference on October 13, NetBox Labs announced partnerships with NVIDIA and Grafana Labs, plus a generally available MCP server and pre-built agents for agentic infrastructure operations — the ‘central intelligence layer’ for AI datacenter buildouts used by 90%+ of top neoclouds.

item.title: NVIDIA declares RTX Spark 'all systems go': Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B lands Oct 15, PAIR exits beta
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: NVIDIA declared the RTX Spark software stack 'all systems go' three days before Friday's laptop launch: the open-weights Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B agent model arrives October 15, the free Personal AI Router (PAIR) exits beta today, and llama.cpp ships a native Windows app.

item.title: Loops raises $3.5M from a16z Speedrun to build one AI layer for all of e-commerce
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Loops, a San Francisco startup building AI for brands and retailers, has raised a $3.5M seed round led by Andreessen Horowitz's a16z Speedrun to build an 'AI operating system for commerce' — one shared AI layer running product search, shopping assistance, customer support, catalog enrichment and virtual try-on.
